Emperor

Country of origin:
Norway
Location:
Notodden, Telemark
Status:
Active
Formed in:
1991
Genre:
Symphonic Black Metal
Themes:
Divination, Nature, Mythology, Individualism, Mysticism
Current label:
Candlelight Records
Years active:
1991-2001, 2005-2007, 2013-2014, 2016-present
Contact: [email protected]

Pictured from left to right: Trym Torson, Ihsahn, and Samoth.

Played their first gig on April 13th, 1992, alongside Enslaved, Algol, and Infinite Decay.

Emperor was known as one of the most infamous Norwegian black metal bands during the early and mid-1990s. Samoth was jailed for 16 months for taking part in church burnings with Varg Vikernes (Burzum), along with ...
